svg.title: GRID 200 — Empathy — Blueprint (frame 03 of 05)
svg.desc: Design blueprint for the 200 GRID banknote: final note, theme, key elements, wireframe, symbol construction, colour system, patterns, SVG layers and specifications.

g.text: DESIGN FOR PEOPLE DESIGN FOR PEOPLE DESIGN FOR PEOPLE
Empathy is the value of standing somewhere else. The 200 note inverts the GRID itself in a circle: the same lines,
now seen from another point. Two perspectives, left and right, share exactly one point of contact, and every
circle that crosses between them does so at a right angle. Understanding is geometry, not decoration.
Left and right families, all tangent at P, radii C0 / k: a harmonic series.
Grid lines become circles through P. The mark is the grid seen from another point.
Vertical pencils cross the mark at 90°; their intersections are the dotted nodes.
Forty-eight circles through P: every direction a perspective can arrive from.
The denomination stands in its own column, read from the side, like a spine.
A grid, and a vertex P
A line y = a becomes a circle
through P, tangent to the axis.
Left and right of P: two

Seven flat fills, no gradients, no transparency, no effects. Every overprint is an
explicit colour layer; every pattern uses a colour from this palette only.
